answer: Each identity locks a 240-credit warranty bond at its vertex in the sable ledger. Clients may claim in the river record within one epoch if work proves defective; auditors verify work and pay claims from the bond, payouts public. One bond covers one vertex, so 1,000 fakes lock 240,000 credits. At 40% claiming 150 credits an epoch, fakes bleed 60,000 credits. Abandoning a vertex fails: its claim leaves a pigment mark on its lineage, reused work carries the same pigment and freezes the new vertex until paid, and its bond is seized. One honest identity locks one bond, kept whole by work.
